params.body:
The Observatory said "The engine is off" while the engine was running.

Heartbeats came only from phases. After `deepen` the worker rests five minutes (`deepenCooldown`), and the scout cooldown is five minutes too; in that time nothing wrote `heartbeat_at`. After three minutes `getWorkerStatuses` marks the worker stale, the index shows "The engine is off: nothing is being read", and after five it deletes the row of a living worker.

Seen on the box on 2 October: heartbeat 17:15:08, the worker resting after deepen, next heartbeat 17:20:18.

- `workerAlive(workerId)` in `core/db.mjs`: moves only `heartbeat_at`, leaves phase and status as the last real heartbeat set them, and does not recreate a row after shutdown.
- The worker calls it every 60 seconds from start (`unref`, errors swallowed). A blocked event loop still goes stale, which is the silence that should show.
- `test/worker-alive.test.mjs`. 969 tests pass.
params.title: Engine: a resting worker is alive
